resolvedIssues: Turning reduced motion off now selects the responsive source and starts playback.
Compact landscape play prompt clears body text, Explore CTA and floating WhatsApp.
Windows WebKit native looping pauses at rewind even with a bare video; guarded application recovery now resumes actual loops without resuming deliberate pauses.
limitations: Windows Playwright WebKit may omit native video request events. Chrome verified zero reduced-motion video requests; WebKit source and playback states were observed directly.
This is desktop Chrome and Windows Playwright WebKit browser verification, not a physical-device test.
